cues.text: Customers choose how they want their shirts: on a hanger, or folded in a box. The ticket tells you which one.
On a hanger: one shirt per hanger. Button the top and middle buttons so it hangs straight.
The collar is straight and flat, and the sleeves hang straight down.
All shirts face the same way, together in one bag.
In a box: fold each shirt on a shirt board, with every button closed.
The collar stands up and is not crushed. Fold the sleeves neatly behind.
Add the collar support and paper band, and stack them in the box all facing the same way.
Quick checks: is it the starch the customer asked for? No broken buttons, and no collar stains left?
And count the shirts. The number must match the ticket.
